verdict.stance: Overweight / Low-Leverage Turkish Consumer Defensive with Offshore FX Cash (BB)
verdict.summary: Ülker posted 19.4% organic ex-IAS 29 sales growth in 9M26 (TRY 95.7bn reported) with conservative 1.45x covenant net leverage (up from 0.97x YE25 after dividends). Offshore hard-currency cash reserves and easing cocoa costs support BB Stable (Fitch) / BB Negative (S&P) on the $550m 7.875% Jul-31 bond (XS2855391533).

positives: Conservative 1.45x covenant net leverage with substantial offshore hard-currency cash.
Dominant Turkish/MENA biscuit & confectionery market share + easing cocoa inflation.
Strategic Consumer market positioning in Turkey supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: S&P Negative outlook on parent Yıldız Holding governance/dividend linkage.
IAS 29 accounting noise and high TRY working capital financing costs.
Exposure to Turkey macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.

background.business_overview: Leading Turkish & regional confectionery/biscuit manufacturer (pladis/Yıldız affiliate).
background.asset_perimeter: Plants in Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Kazakhstan.
background.ownership_governance: Controlled by Yıldız Holding (pladis); BIST listed (ULKER).
